data.title: Predicted Feyenoord line-up: key player available against Como | Goal.com
data.content:
On the right of Feyenoord's attack, Anis Hadj Moussa will start, with the in-form Luciano Valente on the left. Nacho Ferri, who scored against AZ, will lead the line.

Feyenoord impressed against AZ and currently top the Vriendenloterij Eredivisie. Como sit in Serie A's upper mid-table and drew 0-0 with AS Roma on Sunday, when Roma had Donyell Malen sent off.

COM [...] In goal, Tjark Ernst will face the Italians. Givairo Read will start at right-back and Javi López at left-back, with Jeremiah St. Juste and Mika Mármol in the centre of Feyenoord's defence. Tsuyoshi Watanabe is fully fit again and could feature as a substitute.

Van Bronckhorst has no surprises planned in midfield. Charles Vanhoutte, Oussama Targhalline and Gjivai Zechiël will start against Como. [...] COM

COM

Como opened their Champions League campaign with a convincing 4-1 win over RB Leipzig, who face PSV on Tuesday. Feyenoord, meanwhile, lost heavily in Barcelona.

Predicted Feyenoord line-up: Ernst; Read, St. Juste, Mármol, López; Vanhoutte, Targhalline, Zechiël; Hadj Moussa, Ferri, Valente.

data.title: Arsenal vs. Lille (10/13): Live stream Champions League today - nj.com
data.content:
## Team news

Arteta confirmed Piero Hincapie and Martín Zubimendi will miss the game after problems picked up in the warm-down against Leeds. William Saliba is back on grass but still unavailable.

For Lille, defender Tiago Santos and Hamza Igamane are out, and the French club will also have to cope without Ethan Mbappe, who is suspended for the first of three games.

## Predicted lineups [...] Arsenal haven’t lost a Champions League league-phase game since November 2024. This is the first-ever meeting between the clubs.

## Lille look for their first points of the season

Bruno Genesio’s team is second in Ligue 1, but it fell 3-2 at home to Real Betis in its first Champions league effort. Giroud, back in London for the first time with Lille, headlines a side that has been dangerous in attack.

## Team news [...] Arsenal: Raya, Timber, Konsa, Gabriel, Calafiori, Odegaard, Guimaraes, Rice, Saka, Gyokeres, Eze
 Lille: Ozer, Ngoy, Nianzou, Alexsandro, Verdonk, Andre, Bentaleb, Bakwa, Haraldsson, Perrin, Ueda
